name: Decoupled Coarse-Lineage and Luminal-Specialist Hierarchical Multi-Head MIL
summary: We represent each patient's multi-slide H&E tile bag with unreduced, spherically normalised CONCH-Z and H-Optimus-1 embeddings, avoiding PCA variance truncation, and train a decoupled two-stage hierarchical multi-head attention classifier. Stage 1 separates coarse Luminal, Basal, and minority Her2 lineages; Stage 2 trains an independent Luminal specialist for focal LumA-versus-LumB separation, composing calibrated conditional probabilities. Using site-grouped inner tuning within repeated nested patient CV plus site-held-out CV, we determine whether H&E predictability is broad, partial, site-confounded, or insufficient.
preprocessing: Exclude all clinical, immunohistochemistry receptor (er, pr, her2), histological_type, age, stage, RNA-derived, and site variables from predictors and feature transforms; exclude the 259 unlabelled patients from all fitting and scoring.

Pool all slides and up to 128 aligned tiles per slide by patient_id into one patient-level tile bag across the 802 labelled patients so multi-slide patients never straddle any split or bootstrap resample.

Strictly inside each training fold, compute per-feature mean and standard deviation separately for CONCH-Z (768-d) and H-Optimus-1 (1536-d) across training tiles, Z-score standardise, apply per-tile per-encoder L2 unit-sphere normalisation to suppress multiplicative stain-intensity shifts and equalise encoder norm scales, and concatenate into 2304-d unreduced tile embeddings.

Derive stage-specific training targets strictly inside each training fold: a 3-class coarse lineage target (Luminal = LumA or LumB, Basal, Her2) on all training patients for Stage 1, and a conditional binary target (LumA versus LumB) restricted to training Luminal patients for Stage 2.

training.calibration_and_thresholding: Fit scalar temperature scaling separately on inner-validation logits of Stage 1 and Stage 2 before composing 4-class probabilities via P(LumA)=P(Luminal)P(LumA|Luminal) and P(LumB)=P(Luminal)P(LumB|Luminal) for log-loss and AUROC; select prior-adjustment exponent tau in {0.0, 0.25, 0.5} on inner-validation macro-F1 for discrete class assignment.
training.convergence_check: Log per-epoch training loss and inner-validation macro-F1 curves separately for Stage 1 and Stage 2 in every fold; verify solver stabilisation via trailing-5-epoch loss slope magnitude below 1e-3 or validation plateau prior to max_epochs.
training.tie_breaking: Compute inner-fold standard error across the 3 site-grouped inner folds; if candidate configurations lie within 1 SE of the best inner macro-F1, select the lower-capacity stronger-regularised setting.

validation.inner_split_strategy: StratifiedGroupKFold grouped by collection site strictly within each outer training fold (using site solely to define held-out inner validation folds so hyperparameter and calibration selection penalises site-specific staining shortcuts).
required_comparators_on_identical_folds: Majority-class null classifier fit on identical outer training folds (verified via sanity check to output the training majority class with macro-F1 matching analytical single-class expectation)

Stratified class-prior null baseline fit on identical outer training folds (empirical training class probabilities for Shannon entropy and AUROC; deterministic seed-locked class-prior draws for macro-F1)

Inner-tuned class-weighted patient_mean_logreg simple H&E-only reference (grid over single encoder, PCA dim, and C with clinical.use=false) scored on the exact same 802 patients and outer fold indices
validation.site_held_out_validation: 5-fold StratifiedGroupKFold across the 19 collection sites (zero site overlap between train and test, nested inner selection) benchmarked against identical-fold chance floors and simple reference.

metrics: Out-of-fold four-class macro-F1 and paired macro-F1 gain over majority-class and stratified class-prior chance floors across 5x3 repeated nested patient CV with 95% patient-level bootstrap CIs
Paired out-of-fold macro-F1 difference versus the inner-tuned patient_mean_logreg simple image-only reference on identical outer folds with 95% patient-level bootstrap CI
Proportion of class-prior multi-class log-loss (Shannon entropy) explained out-of-fold with 95% patient-level bootstrap CI
Macro and per-class one-vs-rest AUROC across LumA, LumB, Basal, and Her2 with 95% patient-level bootstrap CIs
Per-class recall, precision, and F1 for LumA, LumB, Basal, and Her2 (specifically auditing minority Her2 recall and LumA-versus-LumB confusion)
Site-held-out grouped CV four-class macro-F1 and paired macro-F1 gain over chance across the 19 collection sites with 95% patient-level bootstrap CI
allowed_conclusions: Select strictly one of the four pre-specified conclusions from the 95% patient-level bootstrap intervals: (1) Broad predictability if macro-F1 beats chance in both patient-level and 19-site grouped CV and all four per-class F1 intervals beat chance; (2) Partial predictability if macro-F1 beats chance in both patient-level and site-held-out CV but at least one class fails to beat chance; (3) Site-confounded predictability if patient-level macro-F1 beats chance but the site-held-out paired gain 95% CI includes or falls below zero; (4) Insufficient evidence if the patient-level paired gain 95% CI over chance includes or falls below zero. Scope is restricted to standalone H&E prediction in TCGA-BRCA with frozen foundation encoders, claiming neither incremental gain over clinical receptors nor biological mechanism.
rationale: Flat PCA classifiers confound minority Her2 with LumB and drop low-variance mitotic directions separating LumA from LumB. Decoupling coarse lineage separation from an unreduced-feature Luminal specialist isolates both signals under bottleneck regularisation. Site-grouped inner tuning penalises staining shortcuts without using site as an input.
